info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Create Realestate Listings Offer-v2-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings Offer API allows users to batch insert multiple property offers into the real estate platform. This endpoint is particularly useful for real estate agencies and property managers looking to streamline the listing process by submitting several offers in a single request. It enhances operational efficiency and ensures that property data is consistently updated. Typical consumers include real estate professionals and developers integrating listing capabilities into their applications.

post.summary: Create a new offer for a listing
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new offer associated with a specific listing. You will need to provide the necessary details in the request body, and upon successful creation, the offer will be linked to the listing for future transactions.

requestBody.description: This request body allows clients to submit an offer listing. The JSON payload must adhere to the defined schema, which specifies the required fields and their respective data types needed for creating an offer.
